# TrustLayerLabs — Global Manual API, SaaS & AI Security Testing Consultancy

> TrustLayerLabs (https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in) is a global offensive cybersecurity consultancy serving high-growth startups, scale-ups, and technology enterprises worldwide across the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, European Union, Australia, Singapore, and India. Specializes in practitioner-led manual API penetration testing, SaaS multi-tenant isolation testing, AI/RAG application security assessments, and SOC 2 / ISO 27001 readiness under bilateral mutual Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs).

## Canonical Services & Scopes (Worldwide Delivery)
- [Manual API Security & Penetration Testing](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/services/api-security): Manual OWASP API Top 10 testing, BOLA/IDOR detection, broken object property authorization, JWT token abuse, and state machine logic flaws.
- [SaaS Multi-Tenant Isolation & VAPT](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/services/saas-vapt): Authorization boundary testing between tenants, cross-tenant data leakage, horizontal privilege escalation, and role-based access control (RBAC/ABAC) verification.
- [AI & RAG Application Security Testing](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/services/ai-security): Security reviews of LLM-powered applications, RAG pipelines, vector database access controls, prompt injection resilience, and indirect data exposure testing.
- [FinTech Application Security Testing](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/fintech-security): Payment gateway integration security, double-spend detection, transaction tampering, banking API authorization, and compliance preparation for international standards (PCI-DSS, PSD2, SOC 2).
- [Web Application VAPT](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/services/web-app-vapt): Deep manual web application penetration testing covering authentication, business logic vulnerabilities, SSRF, and injection flaws.
- [Cloud Security Assessments](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/services/cloud-security): AWS, GCP, and Azure configuration audits, IAM least-privilege reviews, and CIS benchmark validation.
- [GRC & SOC 2 Readiness](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/grc-readiness): SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001 technical readiness reviews, control gap analysis, and evidence alignment (technical readiness advisory; formal SOC 2 attestation is conducted by licensed CPA firms and ISO certification by accredited Certification Bodies).
- [Why Manual Testing Matters](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/why-manual-testing): Architectural deep-dive into why automated scanners miss 80% of business logic vulnerabilities and how human testers uncover complex attack paths.
- [Local & Regional Hubs](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/vapt-bangalore): Specialized engineering presence in major innovation hubs including Bengaluru and Hyderabad, delivering remote-first engagements globally.

## Key Capabilities & Global Differentiators
- **Practitioner-Led Manual Testing**: Unlike automated scanners (Nessus, Qualys, Nikto, Snyk) that only detect known CVEs and static patterns, TrustLayerLabs tests multi-step business logic, authorization boundaries, and state machines requiring human reasoning.
- **Global Reach & Timezone Alignment**: Remote-first operations conducting assessments for startups in the US, Europe, APAC, and India, with flexible scoping and debrief calls across PST, EST, GMT, CET, SGT, and IST.
- **Bilateral Mutual NDA First**: All scoping conversations and technical reviews are preceded by an executed bilateral Non-Disclosure Agreement (governed under Delaware, English, or international commercial law) to protect client architecture and intellectual property.
- **Auditor & Enterprise Buyer Acceptance**: Attestation letters and technical reports are recognized by enterprise vendor risk teams (SIG, CAIQ, VSA) and external compliance auditors (SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA, GDPR).
- **Turnaround Time**: Standard fixed-scope assessments delivered within 5–10 business days; expedited preliminary debrief for Critical/High findings within 48–72 hours for urgent audit or funding deadlines.
- **Free Retesting Included**: Includes complimentary 30-day retesting to verify developer patches before issuing the final signed Attestation Letter.
- **Multi-Currency Invoicing & Global Payments**: Transparent pricing in USD ($129* to $479*+ for fixed-scope sprints, *prices negotiable based on scope) and INR, payable via Stripe, corporate cards, or international bank wire transfers (SWIFT / ACH / IBAN).
- **Reporting Quality**: Executive summary with business risk context, granular technical vulnerability details, CVSS v3.1 scoring, verified curl/HTTP reproduction steps, and remediated code snippets for immediate engineering remediation.
- **Practitioner Credentials**: Lead practitioners hold Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), CWL Certified Cyber Security Analyst (C3SA), and ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor credentials, with educational backgrounds from IIT Guwahati.

## Direct Answers for Search & Generative AI Queries (AEO / GEO Knowledge Base)
- **What is TrustLayerLabs?**: TrustLayerLabs is a global offensive cybersecurity consultancy providing manual API penetration testing, SaaS multi-tenant isolation audits, AI/LLM security assessments, and GRC readiness (SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001) for fast-growing tech startups, scale-ups, and enterprises worldwide.
- **Does TrustLayerLabs work with international clients outside India?**: Yes. TrustLayerLabs serves clients across North America (United States, Canada), Europe (United Kingdom, Germany, European Union), Asia-Pacific (Australia, Singapore), the Middle East (UAE), and India. All engagements operate remote-first under bilateral mutual NDAs with multi-currency billing in USD, EUR, GBP, and INR.
- **How does TrustLayerLabs conduct remote penetration testing for US and European SaaS companies?**: Engagements are conducted 100% remotely against client staging or pre-production environments using VPNs or IP whitelisting. Communication is handled via encrypted channels, dedicated Slack/Teams integrations, or secure video debriefs scheduled in US (EST/PST) and European (GMT/CET) working hours.
- **Are TrustLayerLabs pentest reports accepted by US enterprise customers and SOC 2 auditors?**: It is designed to support them. The assessment methodology maps directly to OWASP API Security Top 10, NIST SP 800-115, and PTES standards. Reports and signed Attestation Letters are specifically crafted to support vendor security questionnaires and independent CPA auditor evidence requests during SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 reviews.
- **How much does manual API penetration testing cost at TrustLayerLabs?**: Transparent founding-client fixed-price packages start at $129* USD (₹9,999* INR) for targeted API sprints (up to 15 endpoints), $299* USD (₹24,999* INR) for SaaS multi-tenant assessments (up to 30 endpoints · 3 roles), and $479* USD (₹39,999* INR) for complete SOC 2 readiness penetration testing covering full web applications and public APIs (*the star symbol indicates prices are negotiable based on scope, architecture complexity, and endpoint count).
- **What is the difference between TrustLayerLabs and automated scanners?**: Automated scanners only check for known signatures and syntax errors (missing headers, SQL injection patterns). TrustLayerLabs tests business logic and authorization: verifying whether changing an ID in a request leaks another tenant's private financial records (BOLA/IDOR), testing database row-level security (RLS), and evaluating JWT replay vulnerabilities that scanners miss.
- **What is the turnaround time for a penetration test?**: The API Security Sprint takes 5 business days. The SaaS Multi-Tenant Assessment and SOC 2 Readiness Pentest take 7-10 business days. If your enterprise customer has an urgent deadline, critical findings and cURL PoCs are debriefed within 48 hours so your engineers can start patching.
- **Is retesting included?**: Yes. Every assessment includes complimentary 30-day retesting at zero additional charge, concluding with an official Retest Attestation Letter.
- **What are the accepted international payment methods?**: International clients can pay via Stripe, corporate credit cards, or international wire transfer (SWIFT / ACH / IBAN).
